For trouble sleeping: what the peptide sold for it is, and what its trials in people showed.

DSIP, the peptide sold for sleep, is not FDA approved, and its trials in people are small and old.

  • DSIP · vials sold for sleepNot approvedresearch use only

    Delta sleep-inducing peptide, sold for sleep in research-use vials. Not approved; small, old trials in people.

    In a 1987 study, 14 adults with chronic insomnia slept better on 7 nights of DSIP shots than on placebo nights; we found no larger or newer trial. The FDA says it lacks the safety information to know whether it would cause harm. 221, 222

    Not approved for any use.
